sections.text:
Ability Power 200. Damages all enemies 5 times with physical fire damage with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Ability Power 100. Heals the HP of all allies.
-Increases ATK and MATK of all allies by 120% for 120 seconds.
-Increases ATK and MATK buff limits of all allies by 40% for 120 seconds.
-Casts 30% elevation on all allies for 60 seconds.
-Casts Blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) on your character for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
[Additional Unison Effect] Recovers 30 Cost for all allies.

Archangel Mikaela or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
